reason: A DSH web plugin for uploading or dragging supported documents into the chat composer and extracting their text for use in conversations.

summaries.zh: 一个支持上传或拖拽 PDF、DOCX、PPTX 及纯文本文件并将提取文字填入聊天输入框的 DSH 网页插件。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that extracts text from uploaded or dragged PDF, DOCX, PPTX, plain-text, and code files into the chat composer.

capabilities: Accepts PDF, DOCX, PPTX, plain-text, and code files through file selection or drag-and-drop
Extracts text from supported documents, including server-side PDF parsing
Inserts extracted text into the chat composer with a per-file character limit
